'''Bestul Pelizmo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Inquisitor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who visited the town of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bestul Pelizmo appears as a Sith inquisitor trainer in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released in [[2014]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
